hooks.command: input=$(cat); raw=$(printf '%s' "$input" | grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*"(.*)"/\1/'); path=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed 's/\\\\/\//g'); case "$path" in *Assets*Scripts*.cs) if [ -f "$path" ]; then lines=$(wc -l < "$path" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$lines" -gt 800 ] 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage": "File %s is now %s lines (over the 800-line guideline in CLAUDE.md Architecture Guardrails) - consider a decomposition discussion before adding more."}' "$path" "$lines"; fi; fi ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking file size against the 800-line guideline...
